label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E2 is survey-team-observed prolonged non-use in part of the area, classed as indirect evidence with a target; the national criteria provide no technical survey, so a target area proceeds to clearance. E1 is a weaker second-hand report of non-use associated with an armed-group camp and does not establish EO presence.
flags: E2 describes a field in only part of the recorded area; confirm the defined hazardous-area extent at sign-off. This is a recommendation only, not a final decision.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2.

E1.quote: people stopped using the land at the edge of the pasture after an armed group camped there around 2006, and nobody has used it since
E1.note: This is a second-hand verbal account linking prolonged non-use to an armed-group camp; it suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO.

E2.quote: a field in part of the area has been left unused for years, with collapsed fences and overgrown paths, although the land around it is farmed
E2.note: The survey team directly observed prolonged non-use in part of the area, which is indirect evidence that EO may be present, not confirmation of EO.
